item.p: Substrate, additive (include/sxml/tree.h, frozen by ): sxml_text_event.disables_output_escaping and sxml_node_description.disables_output_escaping, false by default (designated initializers keep every caller as it was). Arena trees keep it in a node flag (the flags field is 16 bits, the node stays 56 bytes); copies (sxml_tree_builder_copy_node) keep it.

Per character (XSLT 4.0, 26.1.8: "an additional boolean property disable-escaping associated with every character in a text node"): inside a parent, text events that differ in the mark make separate text nodes, so <out> with "<" then an unescaped "<" serializes as << (doe-0182 to doe-0186). Such a final result tree has adjacent text nodes, a deviation from XDM 4.0, 6.7.1 limited to trees that use the deprecated feature; parentless text keeps one node.

Where it is set: XSLT lowering of xsl:value-of and xsl:text with disable-output-escaping="yes" (construction flag DISABLES_OUTPUT_ESCAPING on TEXT_CONSTRUCTOR). The request is ignored in temporary output state (26.1.8), with 26.2.6's tracking of xsl:result-document: lexically inside xsl:variable and the other temporary containers the flag is not set; in a template that received the temporary-output-state tunnel parameter it is chosen at run time (sxml_xslt_lowering_bind_received_output_state, shared with xsl:result-document). Not covered: templates reached only through an initial function call (the writer's state), as for XTDE1480.

Where it is honoured: the XML, XHTML and HTML methods write such text in the character context UNESCAPED_TEXT: mapped and normalized, not escaped, never in CDATA sections (26.1.8: CDATA "is treated as an alternative escaping mechanism"), a character the encoding cannot represent as a character reference. Canonical output escapes it; the text method has no escaping. Sequence normalization gives such a text node as a node, not merged, so it keeps the mark at the top level and in xsl:result-document's tree. Attributes, comments, processing instructions and namespaces atomize it and lose it.
Driver: feature disabling_output_escaping is supported; the cases that need it unsatisfied are not run any more.
